color.$description: Semantic tokens: the vocabulary components (via component tokens) and apps consume. Values here are the light theme (the default). Other themes override this contract via stylex.createTheme — see ./themes.

bgHover.$description: Hover wash for rows, menu items, ghost buttons.

bgAccentSubtle.$description: Tinted wash for selected / highlighted items.

fgGradientStart.$description: Gradient text (display headings, wordmark). Both ends meet 4.5:1 on canvas and surface, so the whole gradient is readable.

borderDefault.$description: Decorative dividers and surface edges (no contrast requirement).

borderStrong.$description: Boundaries that identify a control: ≥3:1 against canvas and surface.

brand.$description: Brand colours for decoration and illustration: wordmarks, gradients, empty states, charts. Never for text or control boundaries; those use `color`, which is contrast-audited.

gutter.$description: Responsive: horizontal page padding. Tighter on phones so content keeps its width; components never need their own breakpoint for this.

tight.$description: Display type is optically loose at large sizes; tighten it.

shadow.$description: Elevation for floating surfaces (popovers, dialogs). Shadows are deliberately subtle and rely on a border for definition, so one value reads correctly in both light and dark themes.

thumb.$description: Switch thumb: lifts it off the track.

size.$description: Fixed dimensions. Control heights are responsive: on coarse (touch) pointers they grow to 44px, the WCAG 2.5.5 / Apple HIG target size, so every Button, TextField and Select gets touch-friendly hit areas without a single component-level media query.

contentMax.$description: Layout widths for app shells consuming the system.

thick.$description: Small selection controls, where 1px reads as too faint.

focus.$description: One focus ring for the whole system.

motion.$description: Motion. Durations collapse to 0ms under prefers-reduced-motion here, at the token level, so every transition and entrance animation in the system respects it automatically. `spin` slows rather than stops: a loading spinner is a functional status indicator, not decoration.

spin.$description: Loading spinners keep turning under reduced motion (they're a status indicator, so stopping them would hide that work is happening), but at less than half the speed.

display.$description: Headings and display text: expressive, with an optical-size axis.

sans.$description: UI and body text: neutral and crisp at small sizes.

buttonTokens.$description: Component tokens: the third tier (primitive → semantic → component). Every colour a component paints comes from its own group here. Defaults alias semantic tokens, so they follow the active theme automatically. A theme overrides a component token directly only where the semantic alias isn't right for that component (see themes/dark.ts: the switch). This is what lets a brand restyle one component, e.g. pill-shaped secondary buttons with a tinted background, without touching the semantic layer every other component shares. Each component has two groups: `*Tokens` (colour, themed per mode) and `*Shape` (radius, border weight, type, shadow, motion: themed per brand). Splitting them is what lets a brand change a button's whole character (pill vs square, uppercase mono vs sentence case) once, while light/dark stays a colour-only concern. Aliases resolve where they're declared (:root), which is why themes are applied to <html>. A theme class on a nested element would re-skin semantic tokens but not the component aliases computed above it.

primaryBorder.$description: Invisible by default (matches the fill); brands can outline it.

fieldTokens.$description: TextField input and Select trigger: the "text-like control" surface.

checkedBorder.$description: The checked box's boundary: what carries 3:1 against the surface. Matches the fill by default; brands with pale fills outline instead.

thumb.$description: Thumb on the off track; ≥3:1 against it (WCAG 1.4.11).

thumbOn.$description: Thumb on the on track; may differ when no colour suits both.

trackOffEdge.$description: Track boundaries: what carries 3:1 against the surface. Drawn with width `switchShape.edgeWidth` (0 by default, so the fill is the edge).

fieldsetTokens.$description: Fieldset: a labelled group of related fields.

bg.$description: Boxed variant only. Decorative: the legend identifies the group.

shadow.$description: Resting elevation; brutalist brands use a hard offset shadow.

pressTransform.$description: How the button moves when pressed.

boxRadius.$description: Checkbox corner. Deliberately *not* the brand radius scale: a rounder brand (Bloom's sm is 8px) would turn an 18px box into a near-circle that reads as a radio button. The square-vs-round shape is how users tell multi-select from single-select, so it stays square-ish everywhere. Radios are always circles.

edgeWidth.$description: Outline around the track, drawn outside it so layout never shifts.
